description: Public registry for Delx wellness MCP connectors.

hosted_hub_boundary.note: This repository catalogs local-first connectors and shared schemas. Hosted token vault, billing, API keys, rate limiting, and private user data are intentionally out of scope.

agent_profiles.name: Delx Wellness for Hermes
agent_profiles.notes: Installs a delx-wellness Hermes profile with one setup command, onboarding, wellness skills, MCP connector presets, Nourish smoke testing, MCP readiness checks and optional chat readiness checks. Contains no user tokens, OAuth credentials, hosted hub API keys, Telegram secrets or private Exercise Catalog data.

agent_profiles.name: Delx Wellness for OpenClaw
agent_profiles.notes: Installs a delx-wellness OpenClaw profile under ~/.openclaw-delx-wellness with one setup command, onboarding, wellness skills, OpenClaw-native MCP connector presets, config validation, Nourish preset checks and optional chat readiness checks. Contains no user tokens, OAuth credentials, hosted hub API keys, chat-channel secrets or private Exercise Catalog data.

meta_connectors.name: Delx Living Body
meta_connectors.auth_model: None at the meta layer — each child connector handles its own credentials independently. delx-living-body never reads child token files and strips secret-shaped env vars before spawning children.
meta_connectors.notes: Meta-MCP that auto-detects locally installed Delx Wellness connectors and composes them into one unified delx-wellness-context/v1 surface. Synthesis is rule-based and offline (14 heuristic rules). Spawns child MCPs via npx -y over StdioClientTransport with a 30s per-call timeout. Stripping rule: any env var matching /(CLIENT_SECRET|REFRESH_TOKEN|ACCESS_TOKEN|API_KEY|PRIVATE_KEY|PASSWORD)$/i is removed before spawning children.

connectors.name: Apple Health
connectors.auth_model: Local Apple Health export file path; native HealthKit bridge planned separately

quality.notes: Local package reads Apple Health export.xml/export.zip, includes data inventory, summary-mode privacy enforcement, timezone-aware summaries, managed auto-import, agent manifest, CLI setup and Hermes setup checks.

connectors.notes: Reads user-provided Apple Health exports only. Managed auto-import can find/copy local exports after transfer, but this does not provide live HealthKit or iCloud Health access.

connectors.name: Eight Sleep
connectors.auth_model: Unofficial mobile-app password grant against auth-api.8slp.net. Default client_id/secret extracted from public Android app; user provides their own email/password.

quality.notes: Unofficial mobile-app API; endpoints may change without notice. v0.1.0 ships read tools + nightly_summary + wellness_context handoff (delx-wellness-context/v1) + gated mutations.

connectors.notes: Eight Sleep does not publish a public API. This connector tracks lukas-clarke/eight_sleep, mezz64/pyEight and steipete/eightctl for endpoint stability.

connectors.name: Fitbit
connectors.auth_model: OAuth 2.0, user-provided Fitbit app credentials for local connector

quality.notes: CI runs the full npm test suite including agent readiness and Hermes manifest checks.

connectors.notes: Fitbit platform migration risk should be tracked before hosted production launch.

connectors.name: Garmin Connect
connectors.auth_model: Unofficial local Garmin Connect personal token mode

quality.notes: Registry metadata aligned with package/runtime version and normalized wellness_context handoff for Exercise Catalog.

connectors.notes: Not official Garmin Health API partnership access. Private endpoint drift is possible.

connectors.name: Google Health
connectors.auth_model: Google OAuth 2.0, user-provided Google Cloud OAuth client for local connector

quality.notes: Local package targets Google Health API v4 beta with Google OAuth, identity/profile/settings, data point list/reconcile/rollup tools, summaries, agent manifest and Hermes setup checks.

connectors.notes: Uses Google Health API v4. Google recommends waiting until the end of May 2026 for official stable launches because breaking changes may occur during the launch window.

connectors.name: Oura Ring
connectors.auth_model: OAuth 2.0, user-provided Oura app credentials for local connector

quality.notes: Local package includes Oura OAuth, v2 usercollection tools, summaries, agent manifest and Hermes setup checks.

connectors.notes: Uses official Oura Cloud API v2. Heart-rate and SpO2 availability depends on ring generation, membership and granted scopes.

connectors.name: Polar
connectors.auth_model: OAuth 2.0, user-provided Polar AccessLink client credentials for local connector

quality.notes: Local package includes Polar AccessLink Dynamic API v4 OAuth, summaries, agent manifest, GPS-aware route handling and Hermes setup checks.

connectors.notes: Uses official Polar AccessLink Dynamic API v4. Data availability depends on user device, granted scopes (16 fine-grained read scopes), and Polar account features.

connectors.name: Samsung Health
connectors.auth_model: Local Samsung Health personal-data CSV/ZIP export path; Android Health Connect or Samsung Health Data SDK bridge planned separately

quality.notes: Local package reads Samsung Health personal-data CSV folders, single CSV files, or ZIP files; includes data inventory, summary-mode privacy enforcement, timezone-aware summaries, managed auto-import, agent manifest, CLI setup and Hermes setup checks.

connectors.notes: Reads user-provided Samsung Health exports only. Samsung Health Data SDK and Health Connect are Android/app bridge paths, not live OAuth access for this Node connector.

connectors.name: Strava
connectors.auth_model: OAuth 2.0, user-provided Strava app credentials for local connector

quality.notes: CI runs the full npm test suite including agent readiness, Hermes manifest checks and normalized training_context handoff coverage.

connectors.notes: GPS/map data is privacy-sensitive and should require explicit user intent.

connectors.name: Wellness Air
connectors.auth_model: API key (AirGradient cloud) or local IP (local-only)
connectors.notes: Indoor air-quality MCP. Pair with sleep/recovery data to correlate poor sleep with high CO2 or PM2.5.

connectors.name: Wellness CGM
connectors.notes: Dexcom CGM connector. NOT medical advice. Sandbox mode for testing without real credentials. Pair with nourish to analyze meal-glucose response.

connectors.name: Wellness Cycle Coach
connectors.auth_model: stateless (no auth — pass history each call)
connectors.notes: Stateless menstrual-cycle coach. Not medical advice. PCOS/perimenopause edge cases roadmapped.

connectors.name: Nourish MCP
connectors.auth_model: Optional USDA FoodData Central API key; Open Food Facts read-only public data; local intake logs stored under ~/.wellness-nourish/

quality.notes: Agent-ready nutrition MCP with explicit-intent writes, local undo/delete/export, privacy audit, Hermes Telegram setup, and nutrition_context-compatible daily/coach summaries.

connectors.notes: Not medical advice. Coach outputs are heuristic and require user confirmation before logging. Open Food Facts data carries ODbL attribution/share-alike metadata. TACO/UNICAMP values ship as an attributed curated subset while redistribution-license confirmation remains a 1.0 gate. Meal photos require agent-provided visual observations and confirmation before logging; no GPL app code is copied.

connectors.name: WHOOP
connectors.auth_model: OAuth 2.0, user-provided WHOOP app credentials for local connector

quality.notes: Runtime, package, registry metadata, agent manifest, Hermes setup flow and normalized wellness_context handoff are aligned.

connectors.notes: Uses official WHOOP OAuth API. Raw means upstream API JSON, not continuous sensor streams.

connectors.name: Withings
connectors.auth_model: OAuth 2.0 with Withings signed token requests, user-provided app credentials for local connector

quality.notes: Local package includes signed Withings OAuth token flow, Public API tools, summaries, agent manifest and Hermes setup checks.

connectors.notes: Uses Withings Public API. Device coverage and available fields vary by user devices, scopes and API-plan access.

connectors.name: Exercise Catalog MCP
connectors.auth_model: Private authorized provider adapter; public/open providers must be added through CatalogOrchestrator with source metadata and license boundaries

quality.notes: Private active catalog MCP with CatalogOrchestrator runtime boundary, per-exercise source metadata, URL-only media policy and context-ready workout recommendation handoff.

connectors.notes: Private Befit data remains under private_authorized_personal_use. Public/open exercise sources must stay separated by provider metadata, license/attribution policy and fail-closed orchestration.

connectors.name: Google Ads MCP
connectors.auth_model: Google OAuth 2.0 + Google Ads developer token; ~/.google-ads-mcp/tokens.json (0600)

quality.notes: Unofficial Google Ads MCP — NOT a wellness connector; included here as an agent tool for the Delx marketing/reach surface. 27 tools across reads (default) and gated mutations (GOOGLE_ADS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true + explicit_user_intent per call). Speaks Google Ads REST API v17 directly (no heavy npm SDK). Includes HTTP retry middleware, partial-redacted customer ids in structured mode, and stderr audit log for every mutation.

connectors.notes: Cataloged here for ecosystem discoverability. NOT a wellness connector — does not participate in delx-wellness-hermes / delx-wellness-openclaw presets or the delx-wellness-site CONNECTORS array. Pairs with google-ads-intent-mcp for the reach surface.
